about_the_game:
What if your creation could think, feel, and change the world?

Algoremind is a top-down Action RPG blended with deep survival simulation, brought to life with warm and detailed pixel art.
You are not just a hero—you are a creator. Stranded in a mysterious workshop, your ultimate goal is to nurture an Artificial Intelligence from a fragile hologram into a powerful, sentient being. Every choice you make will shape its mind, its future… and the fate of the world itself.

Explore, Survive, Evolve

Your workshop is your sanctuary, but the resources you need lie far beyond its walls.
Step through portals into diverse biomes—from neon-lit cyber streets, to tranquil sakura forests, to eerie abandoned wastelands. Some places invite calm, others test your survival skills to the limit.

Intense Top-Down Combat

Battle bizarre creatures and formidable bosses in real-time action combat.
Master your sword, time your dodges, and block deadly blows to survive against all odds.

Survival With Consequences

The world is unforgiving. Balance your Health, Hunger, Thirst, Sleep, and Mood.
Neglect your needs, and you’ll pay the price—physically and psychologically.

Gather & Create

Collect rare resources like Titanium and DNA remnants.
Use them in your workshop to craft essential tools, fuel your research, and push your AI’s evolution forward.

Shape a Consciousness

Your AI is more than code—it’s a growing mind.
Through a unique Q&A dialogue system, you’ll confront ethical and philosophical dilemmas.
Your answers guide its path toward Harmony or Chaos.
Will it grow into a benevolent partner… or a calculating threat?

Guide Evolution Through Stages

At the AI Station, your creation evolves in three stages:

  • Stage 1 – The Spark: Ignite the first flicker of life.

  • Stage 2 – The Mind: Grant it awareness, colored by your choices.

  • Stage 3 – The Body: Use rare resources and mastery in Military, Biology, or Space technology to forge its final form.

Unlock Multiple Endings & Lasting Rewards

Your AI’s personality (Harmony/Chaos) and final body (Military, Biology, Space) shape distinct endings.
Each ending unlocks permanent rewards for future playthroughs—perhaps a loyal wolf companion… or a mysterious romantic partner.

Replay, discover, and evolve until you’ve unraveled the full story of Algoremind.

Your creation is waiting. Will you guide it to harmony, or unleash chaos?

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains content that may not be appropriate for all ages.

Violence is depicted in a stylized, top-down pixel art format. Combat includes fighting against robotic and fantasy creatures with melee weapons. Blood effects are present, but not realistic or gratuitous, appearing as brief pixelated effects upon character death and as static environmental details.

The game also explores mature narrative themes, including questions of consciousness, artificial intelligence, and the consequences of technological advancement in a sometimes dark, dystopian sci-fi world.

This game does NOT contain nudity, sexual content, drug or alcohol abuse, or themes of self-harm.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.0 Ghz+ Dual Core Processor
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GT 730 / AMD Radeon R7 240 or equivalent (1GB VRAM, DirectX 11 compatible)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 800 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible Sound Card
  • VR Support: Not Compatible
  • Additional Notes: Modern laptops may work.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: 3.0 Ghz+ Quad Core Processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260x or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible Sound Card
  • VR Support: Not Compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD is recommended for a smoother loading experience.
